neighbours.label: the words of a parenthetical aside: '- and this is', '- and this would be'
fire: It also - and this is the key - saves power.
Because - and this would be the surprise - nobody came.
She also, and this is vital, pays on time.
The car - and this is the best part - runs on water.
It runs - and this will amaze you - for years.
And - this would be the shock - he agreed.
He - and this is rare - said sorry.
Because - and this is odd - it worked.

notes: The + pole of this neuron fires on hedges like 'half in jest', ' especially', ' particularly'. Near misses drop the aside entirely.
